The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Assistant Professor of Agril. Statistics: A Master's degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade) in Agril. Statistics from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University. National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC/ICAR/CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree.

content_sections.text: Rs. 40,000/- per month (consolidated) for Master's Degree holders. Rs. 45,000/- per month (consolidated) for Doctoral Degree holders.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for UAS Dharwad Assistant Professor of Agril. Statistics Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in interview date for UAS Dharwad?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Professor of Agril. Statistics position is scheduled to be held on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for this position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 40,000 per month for Master's degree holders and Rs. 45,000 per month for those possessing a Doctoral degree.

faq.question: Q3. What is the duration of this contract?
faq.answer: This is a temporary appointment on a contract basis for a period not exceeding 179 days.

faq.question: Q4. Is NET mandatory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, NET is generally required, but it is not mandatory for Master's programmes in disciplines where NET is not conducted by UGC, ICAR, or CSIR.

faq.question: Q5. What if I do not have a NET or Ph.D. degree?
faq.answer: In case of non-availability of candidates possessing NET or Ph.D., candidates with only a Master's degree may be considered for the post.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti - 581 115.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Assistant Professor of Agril. Statistics.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry to the interview?
faq.answer: You must carry all original documents, two attested copies of your documents, recent photographs, and a filled application form in two copies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates with a Master's degree in Agril. Statistics or allied subjects with at least 55% marks, along with NET/Ph.D. qualifications, are eligible to attend the walk-in interview.
